[[File:Zombie icon.png|left]]
'''Zombies''' are a form of undead found all over [[Gielinor]], appearing most often in graveyards, dungeons, and tombs. Like [[skeletons]], they are the result of [[necromancers]] reanimating the bodies of the dead. 

Zombies have a wide variety of [[combat level]]s and appearances, but they generally attack with [[melee]] and have a low resistance to magical attacks, particularly [[fire spells]].

Many types of zombies exist, including [[armoured zombie]]s, [[undead one]]s, [[zogre]]s, [[zombie hand]]s, [[monkey zombie]]s, [[zombie pirate]]s, [[zombie swab]]s, and [[dried zombie]]s. When given a [[slayer assignment]] for zombies, any zombie-class creature may be targeted, including [[undead chickens]] and [[undead cows|cows]].

As of an unknown update, zombies are no longer aggressive to low-levelled players.

Many zombie locations are far from banks. These locations are close to banks:
* The [[Draynor Sewers]] are moderately close to the [[Draynor bank]].
* The [[Wizards' Guild]] is very close to the [[Yanille bank]], but it requires level 66 [[Magic]] to enter. In the basement of the Wizards' Guild are eight zombies in a locked cage. This area works as a [[Pay-to-play Magic training|magic training]] spot. Players have to use [[Telekinetic Grab]] to gather any drops, though most drops are worth less than the cost of the [[law rune]]s required. Items next to the fence can, however, be picked up via the [[Drops#Loot interface|loot interface]] if area loot is enabled. Simply drop an item next to the fence and pick it back up to open the interface.

==Champion's Challenge==
Zombies are one of the 'races' who have a lesser champion in the [[Champion's Challenge]] Distraction and Diversion. To fight the [[Zombie Champion]], the player must kill zombies until one drops a [[Zombie Champion's scroll|champion's scroll]], a 1/5000 drop.

While [[undead one]]s count towards a [[Zombies (Slayer assignment)|zombie Slayer asignment]], they do not drop champions' scrolls.

==Update history==
{{UH|
* {{UL|type=update|update=Patch Notes: Early-Game Rebalance|date=16 February 2026}}
** A number of early-game mobs will once again drop actual armour, weapons, ores, and bars.
*** Copper stone spirit → Copper ore
*** Tin stone spirit → Tin ore
*** Tiny plated bronze salvage → Bronze med helm
*** Small bladed bronze salvage → Bronze longsword/Bronze off hand longsword
*** Tiny blunt iron salvage → Iron mace/Iron off hand mace
*** Tiny spiky iron salvage → Iron dagger/Iron off hand dagger
*** Medium plated bronze salvage → Bronze kiteshield

* {{UL|type=patch|update=MHAW & Double XP - This Week In RuneScape|date=15 May 2023}}
** Updated models for [[skeleton]]s, zombies and [[giant rat]]s within the [[Wilderness]], giving them the new [[Unwelcome Guests]] models.

* {{UL|type=patch|update=Unwelcome Guests Slayer Content - This Week In RuneScape|date=11 April 2023}}
** Zombies can be killed as part of the new undead slayer task.

* {{UL|type=patch|update=Patch Notes (9 November 2009)|date=9 November 2009}}
** Reworked various zombie and [[skeleton]] combat animations.

* {{UL|type=patch|update=Patch Notes (25 March 2009)|date=25 March 2009}}
** Stopped a zombie from playing a human animation that made it appear to explode briefly. Zombies in RuneScape have enough to worry about without an irrational fear of spontaneous combustion.

* {{UL|type=update|update=The Lair of Tarn Razorlor|date=22 January 2007}}
** Zombies, [[skeleton]]s and [[ghost]]s have been graphically updated.

* {{UL|type=update|update=Runescape beta is now online!|date=4 January 2001}}
** Added to game.
}}

==Trivia==
* During the [[2010 Halloween event]], hordes of zombies would spawn in the ruins in the [[Clan Wars]] free-for-all arena. Those zombies did not give experience when killed.
* One of the various examines for a zombie is "''Could his name be 'Lurch'?''" This is a reference to the butler in {{WP|The Addams Family}}, {{WP|Lurch (The Addams Family)|Lurch}}.
* An update on [[12 April]] [[2010]] made the sound of the zombies when they get hit much deeper than previously.
* Zombies drop fishing bait commonly. It is revealed in [[Let Them Eat Pie]] and [[Recipe for Disaster]] that fishing bait is actually maggots, which are often found on corpses.
